exposure: Gestational age at first abnormal umbilical artery Doppler
Severity of first abnormal umbilical artery Doppler
outcome: Risk of delivery within 7 days following diagnosis of abnormal umbilical artery Doppler
cohort: The study included 223 liveborn singleton pregnancies complicated by fetal growth restriction and abnormal umbilical artery Doppler from a single referral center between 2016 and 2019.
finding: A previously described prediction model for the risk of delivery within 7 days in patients with fetal growth restriction and abnormal umbilical artery Doppler performed well in an independent cohort, achieving an AUC of 0.865 with 62% sensitivity and 90% specificity.
gest_age: Median gestational age at eligibility was 31.3 weeks, and gestational age at first abnormal umbilical artery Doppler was an exposure variable.
